note: Each frozen implementation is scored on its own: the first auto run per screened case on that version is the score. From engine v9, every case gets three blind runs and every run counts; none is picked. Changing the engine or a run limit starts a new version; every case is rerun and earlier scores stay listed.

versions.72ea5a9e62fc135e496b43179424cc03b1bb468a: First frozen engine, run while the case set was still being built. No indentation-insensitive patch matching.
versions.c985a43a428df1b6f4e1b51ad5fad3346a75d84b: Adds indentation-insensitive patch matching. Output limit 12,000 tokens, prompt limit 96,000 characters: three Ultra replies were cut off before the patch and one case was never sent.
versions.e4179877b102e5e6f343b71aa378602eaf3c4552: Output limit 32,000 tokens, prompt limit 240,000 characters, five-minute call timeout. All 26 cases rerun. Later review: one of its 20 passes (bootstrap-modal-shift-tab-wrap) hardcoded the test page's #confirm-close and #confirm-delete into modal.js; version 6 rejects such patches.
versions.c4c339d4feb3e1a8ae5ee1cd70ef893da952c66f: When a patch does not apply, the model is told which of its lines are not in the file and the closest real line, or where an ambiguous match occurs, instead of a one-line error. Same limits. All 26 cases rerun.
versions.84eb001d07c07e24e6c559db0b3b836a58912a42: Localization follows extensionless, TypeScript and index imports and keeps up to ten source files within 120,000 characters (was five). TypeScript files are syntax-checked after type stripping; the fixture server joins the frozen files. Used for the first open-bug runs only; the 26 cases were not rerun on it.
versions.55874e835c0f72431904aaa778bca8f59fe0c520: Adds an overfitting gate: a patch that makes component code name one of the test page's element ids is rejected and sent back (it caught two earlier passes that hardcoded the page). The browser now records, for each key, whether it was cancelled and whether a dialog's cancel event could be cancelled, and the model sees that trace. All 26 cases and all open bugs rerun.
versions.e64c7d19dc4b0080539009710e31835f4883d61a: When a patch does not apply, the retry gets the file lines it was aimed at and the first line that differs; a path naming only the tail of one allowed file is resolved. Scored 18/26, below v6: most misses were patches that did not apply because the model misremembered an unchanged line (a dropped semicolon, self for this) or copied lines from its own rejected patch. That led to version 8. All 26 cases and all open bugs rerun.
versions.4ee73b81fd1057bef76d7820808d250a8dbeb352: An unchanged line the model misremembered (spacing, a trailing semicolon, self for this) is replaced by the file's own line; changed lines may differ only in formatting and no line may be inserted. Advisory fields nested inside an edit are moved back to the plan, and after an unapplied patch the model is told nothing was applied. Verification is unchanged. All 26 cases and all open bugs rerun.
versions.ea20b4222d1d4a5e3a4c1746e9178d05173d8c14: A patch whose before misremembers, invents or omits context lines is applied hunk by hunk to the real region when the lines it deletes exist verbatim and contiguously, the region is unique and every insertion has a defined place; the ignored context is recorded. An axe finding counts as new only if no recorded path on the original (keyboard, pointer, guards) showed the same rule on the same kind of element. Committed on 2026-10-26 after the first 4 of its runs: every case gets three blind runs on this engine and every run counts; the first run is the score comparable with earlier versions.
versions.9980d4bb6ed51fa6de8df4361811596a2a697271: The page around the library is read-only context: the model sees it without a hash, and an edit to it is refused with the list of component files, so a pass has to change the library (23 earlier passes only worked around the bug in the page). Repairs ask for schema-constrained JSON (response_format), which a recorded probe showed Token Factory honours for Nemotron 3 Super and Ultra; a reply that still does not parse has only its bracket structure repaired. Committed on 2026-10-26 before any run: three blind runs per bug, every run counted; the first run is the score comparable with earlier versions.
